# SPDX licence texts

The standard texts of the licences Mako's control driver's crates name, for the crates whose packages carry no licence
file of their own (`scripts/driver-third-party-notices.mjs`). Each file is `text/<identifier>.txt` from the SPDX
licence list, release v3.25.0 (https://github.com/spdx/license-list-data/tree/v3.25.0/text), unchanged.

To add one a build asks for, take the same file from the same release.
